layout_dets.text: Abstract

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Curvilinear structure segmentation (CSS) plays a vital role

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: in industrial applications, including medical imaging and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: structural health monitoring. Recently, the strong capacity of

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the Segment Anything Model (SAM) has inspired its down-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: stream application in CSS tasks. To adapt SAM to CSS tasks,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: previous methods heavily rely on a certain number of samples

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and costly pixel-level annotation, which are hard to access for

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: a new scenario. Considering this, the goal of our work is to

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: adapt SAM in a very cost-effective setting where only a single

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: unlabeled image is given. This is far more challenging than

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the typical supervised, unsupervised, or self-supervised learn-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ing manner that needs a large number of training samples. To

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tackle this problem, we propose a finetuning-free SAM for

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: curvilinear structure segmentation, called curvilinear-aware

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: prompt learning (CaPro), which aims to automatically learn

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: visual prompts via a single unlabeled image. In the first stage,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: we generate extensive curvilinear structures and oriented sub-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: curvilinear box annotations. To increase the realness of gener-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ated curvilinear structures, we adapt these structures into real

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: image domains via the Fourier Transform using a single real-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: world unlabeled image. Now, these adapted images can be

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: used to train our oriented sub-curvilinear detector. In the sec-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ond stage, we propose the curvilinear-aware discrete repre-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: sentation matching to filter those unreliable detection results.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Afterward, these reliable detection results can be converted

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: into informative prompts, contributing to the cost-effective

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: SAM adaptation to CSS tasks. Experiments demonstrate the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: effectiveness of CaPro on medical image and crack segmen-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tation tasks.

layout_dets.text: Introduction

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Curvilinear Structure Segmentation (CSS) shows its great

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: importance in various real-world applications including in-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: dustrial crack segmentation (Chen et al. 2024a) and medi-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: cal blood vessel segmentation (Chen et al. 2024b). It aims

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: to segment binary masks of those curvilinear objects, which

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: can advance structural health monitoring in industrial sce-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: narios (Liu et al. 2021) or assist doctors with lesion diagno-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tial progress in the CSS tasks lies in the rise of deep learning

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: (Zou et al. 2018) and JTFN (Cheng et al. 2021) successfully

layout_dets.text: cracks in an end-to-end manner. Later, with the witness of

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the success of Vision Transformer (ViT) in natural images

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: (Li et al. 2024a; Li, Xiong, and Fan 2024), CrackFormer

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: (Liu et al. 2021) shows the effectiveness of ViT in capturing

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: long-range interactions (Wang et al. 2024a). However, these

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: approaches require substantial annotated data.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Considering the remarkable capabilities of the Segment

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Anything Model (SAM) (Kirillov et al. 2023), previous

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: works (Ge et al. 2024; Xu et al. 2024) argue that SAM can

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: be an ideal solution to overcome the limited availability of

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: labeled samples in CSS tasks. However, directly applying

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: SAM to CSS tasks in zero-shot settings results in very lim-

layout_dets.text: Crack dataset. Although existing prompt-free (Chen et al.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 2023a; Cheng et al. 2024) and prompt-based (Feng, Zhu,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and Yu 2023; Leng et al. 2024) SAM adaptation methods

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: can greatly improve SAM performance on CSS tasks, these

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: methods still rely on pixel-level annotations. Notably, it is

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: labor-intensive to collect enough training samples form a

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: new scenario (Lei, Zhong, and Dai 2024). Moreover, due to

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the complex curvilinear structures with ambiguous bound-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: aries, such pixel-level labeling is time-consuming and relies

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: on experienced experts. To this end, one remaining unex-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: plored challenge arises: How can we adapt SAM to CSS

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tasks in a far more challenging and realistic scenario, where

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: only a single unlabeled training image is provided?

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Inspired by FreeCOS (Shi et al. 2023), a naive solution

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: is to leverage synthetic data to train the horizontal object

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: detector in a self-supervised manner. Afterward, such a de-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tector can provide prompts for SAM without any labeling

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: costs. However, Table 1 shows that this simple approach

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: yields suboptimal performance for two reasons: (i) The hor-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: izontal object detectors can not adapt to curvilinear struc-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tures that involve varying orientations. (ii) The prompts from

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: those unreliable detection results would devastate SAM per-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: formance. To address these problems, here are two insights:

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: • Curvilinear structures can be viewed as line objects with

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: a certain orientation from local perspectives.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: • As shown in Fig. 4 (b), handwritten digits and curvilin-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ear structure masks share topological isomorphism.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Therefore, we propose curvilinear-aware prompt learn-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ing (CaPro), a two-stage framework for adapting SAM to

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: CSS tasks without the SAM fine-tuning process. Our key

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: idea is that the self-supervised oriented curvilinear object

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: detector can be realized via curvilinear structures synthe-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: sis with a single unlabeled image, and then it can provide

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: more informative prompts by filtering those unreliable ones.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Specifically, in the first stage, motivated by the first in-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: sight, this is the first-of-its-kind work that detects curvilinear

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: structures in a self-supervised oriented detection manner. To

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: achieve this, we synthesize curvilinear structures using para-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: metric fractal L-Systems (Zamir 2001) and generate the cor-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: responding oriented bounding boxes. These structures are

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: then adapted to real image domains via the Fourier Trans-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: form using a single unlabeled image. In return, many real-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: istic synthetic samples with oriented bounding box annota-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tions can be obtained. Afterward, our proposed customized

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: oriented detector can be trained in a self-supervised manner

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: with the help of the above synthetic data. Then, it enables

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: automatic detection of curvilinear structures, and generates

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: prompts for the SAM. In the second stage, motivated by the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: second insight, we propose curvilinear-aware discrete rep-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: resentation matching that leverages shared patterns between

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: curvilinear structure and handwritten digits, to filter those

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: unreliable detection results. In this way, SAM performance

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: can be greatly enhanced by providing more reliable prompts.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Our contributions are summarized as:

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: • To the best of our knowledge, we are the first ones

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: to adapt SAM to CSS tasks via self-supervised prompt

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: generation without the costly SAM fine-tuning process.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: For this cause, this paper proposes the curvilinear-aware

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: prompt learning (CaPro) that can serve as a plug-and-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: play module for the existing prompted-based SAM.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: • Propose the image-label pair curvilinear structures syn-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: thesis that enables our oriented detector to act as prompt

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: generation module in an self-supervised manner.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: • Propose the curvilinear-aware discrete representation

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: matching that acts in an self-supervised manner, to filter

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: out unreliable prompts from inaccurate detection.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: • A labeled vessel segmentation dataset has been con-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: structed, namely, OCT1600, which contains challenging

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: samples with complex curvilinear structures, to facilitate

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the research on CSS tasks.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Related Work

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Curvilinear Structure Segmentation: Curvilinear Struc-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ture Segmentation receives extensive attention from various

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: applications, e.g., crack detection (Liu et al. 2021; Lei et al.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 2025), and biomedical image segmentation (Lei et al. 2024;

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Wang et al. 2019). Crackformer (Liu et al. 2021) achieves

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: great success by embedding a novel Transformer encoder

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: module. Despite these models’ great success, these models

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: rely on extensive labeled crack samples for a new scenario

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and suffer from insufficient generalizability when faced with

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: limited labeled training samples. To alleviate the annotation

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: costs, (Lin et al. 2023) proposes a sparsely annotated seg-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: mentation framework. Meanwhile, (Carneiro-Esteves, Va-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: cavant, and Merveille 2024) leverage real-world masks for

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: obtaining pairs of connected/disconnected curvilinear struc-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tures. FreeCOS (Shi et al. 2023) generates curvilinear struc-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tures for training segmentation models.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Herein, ours is distinct from these works in two-fold: (1)

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: We perform CSS by adapting SAM via our self-supervised

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: prompt generator without any annotation costs, SAM fine-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tuning process, and training segmentation models. (2) Un-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: like the FreeCOS (Shi et al. 2023) generates curvilinear-like

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: structures to enlarge segmentation training sets, we focus on

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: image-label pair curvilinear synthesis for oriented curvilin-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ear object detection. Then, we greatly boost the SAM perfor-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: mance on CSS tasks via our curvilinear-aware discrete rep-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: resentation matching to filter out those unreliable prompts.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Vision Foundation Models for CSS Tasks: Since this pa-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: per focuses on leveraging large-scale foundation models for

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: CSS tasks, we briefly review related research on this scope.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Foundation models can serve as a new general paradigm of

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Artificial Intelligence (AI), showing its stronger intelligence

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: than traditional models (Ge et al. 2024). Generally speak-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ing, foundation models are pre-trained, large-scale models

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: that allow for fast customization through fine-tuning (Wang

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and Li 2023a,b; Ye et al. 2024). Despite this great progress,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: it is not feasible to directly apply SAM for CSS tasks. The

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: reason is that SAM does not encounter semantics related to

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: curvilinear structures, such as cracks (Ye et al. 2024). Then,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: a few works attempt to fine-tune SAM to learn the specific

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: semantics of curvilinear structures (Ge et al. 2024; Ye et al.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 2024; Rakshitha et al. 2024). Ye et al. (Ye et al. 2024) and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Ge et al. (Ge et al. 2024) utilize low-rank adaptation (LoRA)

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Object Detector as Prompt Generator for SAM: Gener-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ally speaking, this paper mainly focuses on leveraging an

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: oriented object detector as a prompt generator to adapt large-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: scale foundation models to CSS. To this end, we present the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: related research in this area. Previous object detection meth-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ods for CSS tasks exploit horizontal bounding boxes to de-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: scribe the location and the coarse size of curvilinear objects.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Considering this, most existing detectors utilize the com-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: monly used detectors in general computer vision tasks, e.g.,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Faster R-CNN (Ren et al. 2016), RetinaNet (Lin et al. 2017),

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Yolo (Redmon et al. 2016), CenterNet (Zhou, Wang, and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Krähenbüh1 2019), and SSD (Liu et al. 2016). Rakshitha et

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: al. (Rakshitha et al. 2024) integrates Detectron2 with SAM

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and train the object detection model using images and masks

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: to generate approximate boundary boxes. However, previous

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Experimental Setup. As this paper focuses on curvilinear

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: structure segmentation tasks, we adopt the following related

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: datasets for evaluation. Our OCT1600 dataset contains 1600

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: OCT projection images of the size 448 × 448 which are col-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: lected from real-world applications with fixed fields of view.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: The OCTA500 dataset has two different field of view types

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: named OCTA-500_3M, and OCTA-500_6M. Compared to

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the 3M images, the vessels in the 6M images are more com-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: plicated, and the foveal avascular zone is smaller. Therefore,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the segmentation tasks of 6M are more challenging com-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: pared to 3M. For this reason, we follow the existing work

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: (Chen et al. 2025a) and use the 2-D projection image of

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the size 400 × 400 from OCTA-500_6M. The DeepCrack

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: dataset (Liu et al. 2019) contains curvilinear structures of

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: cracks and consists of 537 images with manually annotated

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: crack masks. All of the images involve a fixed size of 544

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: × 384. Each dataset is divided into training, validation, and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: testing sets at a ratio of 7:1:2. The Drive dataset (Staal et al.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 2004) consists of 20 training and test retinal images of size

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 565 × 584. We randomly select a single image in the training

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: set as our training image. The MNIST dataset (LeCun et al.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 1998) is used to learn informative codebooks for storing

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: curvilinear structure features. It contains 70000 greyscale

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: images of handwritten digits, where 60000 labeled images

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: are for testing to select the best model by the reconstruction

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: error between the original and output image.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.text: Conclusion

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: We propose Curvilinear-aware Prompt Learning for adapt-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ing SAM to CSS tasks without requiring the SAM fine-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tuning process and human annotation. Inspired by the fact

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: that informative point prompts can help SAM to easily seg-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ment those curvilinear structures, this paper aims to au-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tomatically learn visual prompts with a single unlabeled

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: image. To this end, we first propose the prompt-oriented

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: training data synthesis that enables our customized oriented

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: detector to act as a prompt generation module in a self-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: supervised manner. Then, we explore the fact i.e., handwrit-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ten digits and curvilinear structure masks share common pat-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: terns, and then learn codebooks to store those curvilinear

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: representations, which allows us to filter those unreliable

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: prompts via curvilinear-aware representation matching.
